Ava (People Ops): heads up — our temp badge printer by the front desk just jammed. Dr. Chen is here with a fragile crate and her visitor badge didn't print :grimacing:
Liam: I can run down in 5. do you want me to meet them at the curb? :wave:
Ava (People Ops): yes please, curb pickup would be amazing. also the crate says FRAGILE but no courier label. can you check the courier name when you get there?
Front Desk Bot: Visitor arrival logged: Dr. Mei Chen. Expected time 11:10. No badge issued (printer error).
Marisol: if Liam needs a seat, we can hold the small sofa in the lobby or open conf A for 30 mins. which would they prefer?
Liam: grabbing the crate now. courier on site says they were 'dropping off for Redwood' and left it with the visitor. i'll ask for ID and take a photo of any label.
Raj: if it's unlabelled, please leave it at the secure parcel locker and note it in #people-ops-packages. we had a mix-up last month.
Liam: quick update — there was a handwritten slip 'urgent demo' but no company name. i've left it at locker 3 with a note: "Dr. M. Chen — front desk to confirm" and took pics.
Ava (People Ops): thanks. Marisol please set aside conf A — I'll print a manual temporary badge from the admin laptop and meet them.
Marisol: conf A reserved until 12:00. placing a 'Visitor' sign on the door. :white_check_mark:
Front Desk Bot: Temporary badge issued manually by Ava at 11:18. Badge ID: TEMP-4621. Access limited to lobby + Conf A.
delivery-bot: courier arrival logged at 11:12 from 'GoodHands Couriers' (no manifest scanned).
Ava (People Ops): all set — Dr. Chen checked in, badge given, escorted to Conf A. I've added the parcel photos to the package tracker and pinged security to keep an eye on unattended items. Thanks Liam! :heart:
Liam: no prob. printer jammed — i cleared paper and reset it, seems ok now. leaving a sticky note on it about delicate badge stock.
Raj: awesome, closing the loop. can someone remind us to add 'check handwritten slips for courier' to the front desk SOP?
